title: Rabbi Yehudah bar Abba
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mishnah Eduyot 8:2 mentions him in the Western Mishnah reading, testifying together with Rabbi Yehudah the Priest about a minor Israelite girl married to a priest, etc. At the beginning of chapter 6 he testifies to five matters, including encouraging minor girls to refuse their marriages through miun. The ordinary reading is Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava.

notes.text: The name differs between Yehudah bar Abba and the ordinary Yehudah ben Bava. Miun is a minor girl’s refusal of the marriage; the testimony concerns its use for minor girls.
The consulted ordinary Mishnah texts at Eduyot 8:2 and 6:1 read Rabbi Yehudah ben Bava. The Western Mishnah reading Yehudah bar Abba is reported here from Hyman.
